data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Delta Studio is a price comparison portal in Germany, helping thousands of users find the best deals online every day.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and help build our price comparison platform.

We are currently offering the following position:

Software Engineer - Price comparison portal

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain features for our price comparison platform
  • Develop and optimize data pipelines that process merchant price feeds
  • Work closely with Product and BI to ship reliable, scalable features
  • Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews

data.title: Freelance Video Editor (w/m/d)
data.description:
Hi, wir sind Kelp Networks.

Wir sind die E-Commerce-Agentur für Winzer und bringen unsere Partnerweingüter mit guten Shops, klarer Kommunikation und wirksamen Werbeanzeigen nach vorne.

Für unsere Videoprojekte suchen wir feste Freelance-Unterstützung: jemanden, der sicher in DaVinci Resolve Studio schneidet, KI selbstverständlich nutzt und vereinbarte Aufgaben zügig fertigstellt.

Zum Start warten verschiedene bestehende Projekte und Re-Edits mit insgesamt etwa 10–20 Stunden Aufwand. Danach planen wir langfristig mit ungefähr 4–8 Stunden pro Monat

data.title: Director of Engineering – Catalogue (m|w|d)
data.description:
As Director of Engineering you take end-to-end ownership of one of Lotus’s most critical engineering domains. Catalogue is at the heart of our product: it turns millions of merchant offers into trusted, comparable and discoverable product information for our users.

You will lead an organization of around 50 engineers across seven teams, working through Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders. Your responsibility goes beyond technology: you create the conditions for strong teams to deliver predictably, evolve our technical landscape and turn our product and business strategy into measurable outcomes.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
data.description:
What you can expect from us

Moss Works supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. 

For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies.
